## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I started from scratch and first looked at the github repository that was provided for help. I followed each thing step by step and used the help of google, gemini ai, and youtube when I was stuck on

**8h**

I started from scratch and first looked at the github repository that was provided for help. I followed each thing step by step and used the help of google, gemini ai, and youtube when I was stuck on something. I was doing all of this with my younger brother individually, so it was easier because I told him when I figured out how to do something and he told me things he figured out as well. We were first stuck on what to label and how to change the layout so that it was all connected but then we figured it out by playing a bit with the whole software. I also had to delete some things from my computer to make storage for the things we had to download. I was stuck on the edge cutting part and then the wiring but then I got the hang of it. Unfortunately I don't have the parts yet but that is still yet to be completed. Thankfully, I have gotten pretty far in this project and it is working out great so far.
